name: Noble Blood
text: When this fighter is recruited, pick 1 skill for them.

name: Spellcraft
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Blood**. When they are recruited, pick 1 spell from it to be their signature spell. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Master of Necromancy
text: This fighter knows the **Lore of Necromancy**. When they are recruited, pick 2 spells from it to be their signature spells. In addition, at the start of each battle they prepare 1 random spell from it.

name: Bestial Transformation
text:
Once per battle, at the start of this fighter’s activation it can *transform*. If it does so, remove this fighter from the battlefield and set up the Lycanfell Beast at the same location (or as close to it as possible). Any damage the Lycanfell Noble has suffered, the Lycanfell Beast has also suffered.

The Lycanfell Beast immediately makes its activation.

name: Bloodline Mutations
text:
When this fighter is recruited, you can pick 1 of the following bloodline mutations, (each comes with a silver cost):

- *Bat Wings (+15 silver):* This fighter has the *Fly* keyword.
- *Wulfen Legs (+10 silver):* This fighter's Move value is 7".
- *Hulking Form (+30 silver):* This fighter's Life value is 8.

name: Trackers
text: Each aftermath sequence, when you search the city. If your search party includes any Dire Wolves, you can re-roll the exploration roll.
